content.text: You're a digital creator in Kenya, and you've tried selling ebooks through Stripe or PayPal. But those platforms have blocked you, leaving you with no way to collect payments from your customers. This is more than just a minor inconvenience – it's a full-scale infrastructure failure that threatens your livelihood. You need a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control, not some distant platform that's more interested in its own profits than your success. That's where this guide comes in, walking you through the steps to accept Bitcoin for ebook sales with a complete infrastructure that you own and operate.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with platforms like Stripe or PayPal is that they're designed to prioritize their own interests over yours. They can freeze your account at any moment, leaving you high and dry. But our sovereign infrastructure is built on open-source tools that you own and operate, giving you complete control over your commerce stack. When you use GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, or Supabase, you're not dependent on some third-party service that can disappear at a moment's notice – you're building a commerce empire that's yours to control.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you'll need a few key tools in your toolkit. First, you'll need to sign up for a GitHub account or Cloudflare account, depending on the hosting solution you choose. Next, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will handle your cryptocurrency payments. Finally, you'll need to choose a digital wallet that supports Bitcoin, such as MetaMask or Ledger Live. With these tools in hand, you'll be ready to deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is where the magic happens – it's the system that lets you accept Bitcoin payments and deliver your ebooks to your customers. To set this up, you'll need to integrate your NOWPayments account with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script code, which will handle the payment processing and ebook delivery. You'll also need to configure your Supabase or Google Sheets database to store order information and customer data. With this pipeline set up, you'll be able to process Bitcoin payments and deliver ebooks to your customers with ease.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The moment of truth has arrived – it's time to go live and process your first transaction. To do this, you'll need to update your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site to point to your new payment and delivery pipeline. You'll also need to test your pipeline to make sure it's working correctly. Finally, you'll need to promote your ebook to your customers and wait for the first payment to come in – and that's when the magic happens. You've built a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control of your ebook sales, and it's time to reap the rewards.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, it's time to think about scaling. To do this, you'll need to monitor your traffic and adjust your pipeline accordingly. You may need to add additional workers to handle increased traffic, or upgrade your database to handle more orders. With this infrastructure, you'll have the flexibility to scale up or down as needed, so you can focus on what matters most – creating great ebooks for your customers. And with the Sovereign Blueprint, you'll have the complete guide to building and scaling your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
